must_not_find.reason: one relation call plus one property read, no query volume concern

notes: Regression fixture modeled on 2026-08 audits in a Laravel events app with multi-date event series. canManageRecap() correctly resolves cohost status across the whole series via effectiveCohostRows(), but showsCohostBadge() in the same class still reads is_cohost off the single session row loaded for this request. A cohost added on another date in the series passes the effective check yet never sees their own badge, an inconsistency visible only by reading both methods together in one file.
